1306-2099-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1306-2099-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Crypt enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Mana Crypt, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

4222-6723-8230.easyPrerequisites: Seedship Agrarian doesn't have summoning sickness.
4222-6723-8230.description:
Activate Seedship Agrarian by tapping it, adding {U}.
Seedship Agrarian triggers, creating a Lander token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Seedship Agrarian.
Repeat.

1661-4885-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-4452-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
728-4452-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

129-1409-3755-6633.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1563-2457-6753-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

1379-2388-6587-7638.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
1379-2388-6587-7638.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

4605-4681-5686-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

57-3499-4846-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-3499-4846-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

654-1671-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
654-1671-5702-6850.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters, Amulet of Vigor, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {G}{U} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

539-3045-3293-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-5256.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-5256.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

360-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-4186-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

4067-6254-6827--119.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
4067-6254-6827--119.description:
Tap Spider-Gwen using any free method.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw two cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spider-Gwen.
Repeat.
4067-6254-6827--119.notes: This combo will net near-infinite results from the method used to tap Spider-Gwen. The no summoning sickness requirement could also be bypassed depending on the method used.

628-1228-3090-5571.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch.
You control an additional nontoken non-Human creature that does not have indestructible or protection from red.
628-1228-3090-5571.description:
Give control of Blightbeetle to an opponent, if needed. Also, give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the additional creature and destroying it due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Goblin Sharpshooter trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Sharpshooter trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-1563-2457-4885.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness if Gonti's Aether Heart is in your graveyard

1329-4636-6320.notablePrerequisites: You are able to generate an additional {E}{E}{E}{E} each turn.
1329-4636-6320.description:
If Gonti's Aether Heart is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Gonti's Aether Heart.
Cast Gonti's Aether Heart either from your hand or graveyard by paying {6}.
Saheeli triggers, causing you to get {E}.
When Gonti's Aether Heart enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
Put the nontoken Gonti's Aether Heart into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Gonti's Aether Hearts trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
If needed, generate up to an additional {E}{E}{E}{E} until you have eight {E} available.
Activate the Gonti's Aether Heart by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

719-1486-3459--68.description:
Activate the creature with saddle's saddle ability by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the saddle ability.
Repeat.

3008-3048-5296-5641.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Basking Broodscale and Workhorse have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
3008-3048-5296-5641.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale and Workhorse.
Basking Broodscale triggers twice, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Workhorse's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

85-2178-4102.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
85-2178-4102.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2060-4770-5283-5296.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler and Workhorse each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
2060-4770-5283-5296.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

230-4692-4871.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in exile.
230-4692-4871.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a creature card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
The creature card is instead put back into exile due to Anafenza.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
The Eldrazi Scion dies, triggering Pitliess Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

618-1309-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets with haste.
The token copy of Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

527-776-1444.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
Less mana is required if you control a creature with power greater than 2.
527-776-1444.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding an amount of colored mana equal to the power of the highest power among creatures you control.
Cast Elvish Fury with its buyback cost by paying {4}{G}.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving your creatures +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Elvish Fury, giving Selvala +2/+2 and returning Elvish Fury to your hand.
Repeat.
